Starter: a header, a footer and a two-column page layout with placeholder text, ready to restyle.

Create it

mkdir starter && cd starter
bunx @crombolo/cli@latest init --template starter
bun install

Start it

bun start

The site is served on http://localhost:8080/.

The first start applies the template's content and publishes it. The back office is at http://localhost:8080/crombolo, and the start prints how to sign in (Getting started).

What is in it

  • a content page and a search page type;
  • a header, a footer and a two-column page layout in components/, with placeholder text;
  • a home page with About, Contact and Search pages beneath it.

Where to look first

Restyle components/shared/ and the stylesheet in css/, then replace the placeholder text in the back office or with crombolo content update.
